name: move
description: 移动或重命名文件/目录（替代 terminal 的 mv/Move-Item，全程可 undo）。支持批量（sources 数组）。同盘优先原子 rename；跨盘自动回退递归复制+删除。安全校验：roots 越权、symlink 遍历、Windows 根路径、dev vault（.git）防护、目录大小上限（100MB）。overwrite 策略：error（默认，目标存在即失败）/ rename（自动重命名避开冲突）/ overwrite（覆盖目标，改前自动备份）。
description_en: Move or rename files/directories (use instead of terminal mv/Move-Item, undo supported throughout). Supports batching (sources array). Prefers atomic rename on the same volume; automatically falls back to recursive copy+delete across volumes. Safety checks: roots escape, symlink traversal, Windows root paths, dev vault (.git) protection, directory size limit (100MB). Overwrite strategies: error (default, fail if destination exists) / rename (auto-rename to avoid conflicts) / overwrite (replace destination with automatic pre-change backup).

source.description: 源文件/目录的绝对或相对路径（单源模式，与 sources 互斥）
source.description_en: Absolute or relative path of the source file/directory (single-source mode, mutually exclusive with sources)

sources.description: 批量源路径数组（多源模式，与 source 互斥；此时 dest 必须是已存在的目录）
sources.description_en: Array of source paths for batch mode (multi-source mode, mutually exclusive with source; dest must be an existing directory)

dest.description: 目标路径。单源时可为新路径或已存在目录（移入）；多源时必须是已存在目录
dest.description_en: Destination path. In single-source mode it can be a new path or an existing directory (move into it); in multi-source mode it must be an existing directory

overwrite.description: 目标已存在时的策略：error=报错（默认）；rename=自动改名（如 name (1).ext）；overwrite=覆盖（覆盖前对目标做备份，支持 undo）
overwrite.description_en: Strategy when destination already exists: error=fail (default); rename=auto-rename (e.g. name (1).ext); overwrite=replace (backs up the destination first, undo supported)

dryRun.description: 预演模式：返回将执行的移动清单，不执行任何操作
dryRun.description_en: Dry-run mode: returns the list of moves that would be performed without executing anything
